name: @nanoclaw/ui-chat
description: Browser chat UI for NanoClaw. Bundled with esbuild; output checked in at dist/app.js.

scripts.build:no-typecheck: esbuild src/appearance-bootstrap.ts --bundle --format=iife --target=es2022 --outfile=dist/appearance.js && esbuild src/index.tsx --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --sourcemap --outfile=dist/app.js && esbuild src/private-web-entry.tsx --bundle --format=esm --target=es2022 --sourcemap --outfile=dist/private-web.js
